July 15  2026was one of the hardest days for me. I lost my job, and with it, I suddenly lost 3.5 years of connections, memories, and friendships. I didn’t even get the chance to say a proper goodbye. 💔

To my favourite person and my constant source of support, Sohana — I’m truly sorry I couldn’t say goodbye properly. Thank you for always being there, for your support, and for all the beautiful memories.

Some goodbyes are never said, but some people will always remain in our hearts. ❤️

Goodbye, Sohana. Take care and stay happy. 🥺💔
